race.comment: SIGLO DE ORO (6) improved sharply on his fourth two starts back at Ballina with success as favourite over 1100m at Gatton four weeks ago, getting home by half a length after being in contention on the corner. Finds an easier assignment and can continue the winning form. SOUTHAMPTON NICCO (8) found the line nicely last start to get up for second at Inverell. Should camp just off the leaders. Expecting a bold showing. DEEP STEALTH (3) is going well this campaign and found the line strongly latest when fourth at Grafton. Record at this journey is impressive with two wins and two placings from six runs and is one of the contenders. PRESTIGE PAK (5) produced a better run last start when finishing fourth over 860m at Gatton. Capable of featuring prominently. MONACO FLYER (10) showed good tactical speed fresh and fought on gamely in the lane to finish second. Fitter now and can go one better.
